reviewed_by: Codex manual Radare2 versus candidate x86-source review, 2026-10-19

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Reviewed retail disassembly at 0x004CEAA0 through sibling traversal and out-size handling at 0x004CEB61. Retained BN/r2 structural records, without adopting their stale claimed byte length as a boundary proof.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail context at esp+4, tag esp+8, size pointer esp+12; three pushed callee-saved registers shift those offsets. Test uses explicit x86 cdecl pointer,int,pointer prototype.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Reviewed byte-swap shifts/masks, initial +12 offset, limit base+8+big-endian size, successor step 8+((size+3)&~3). Tested seven payload lengths covering each alignment residue.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Fixture compares complete 1024-byte arena including out-size sentinel. Sibling sizes and tags stored big-endian, payload returned at chunk+8.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No calls; only optional out-size is written. Tested first, middle, last and absent tags with both null and non-null size output.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Match returns payload; unsigned successor >= limit returns null. Candidate shares these tested paths; malformed FORM data and arithmetic wraparound are outside this review scope.

limitations: Valid bounded big-endian FORM sibling chunks only; malformed sizes, wraparound and invalid pointers excluded.
Concrete angr execution, not a live game run or universal equivalence proof.
No independent second reviewer; status stays STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
